item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
work_tmp=$(mktemp -d "$TMPDIR/govt-college-badod-epravesh.XXXXXX")
for url in '"'https://epravesh.highereducation.mp.gov.in/' 'https://epravesh.highereducation.mp.gov.in/College' 'https://epravesh.highereducation.mp.gov.in/college' 'https://epravesh.highereducation.mp.gov.in/Home/CollegeList'
do
  name="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$url" | sed '"'s#["'^A-Za-z0-9]#_#g'"')
  curl -k -L --silent --show-error --max-time 40 -w \" "'$url status=%{http_code} final=%{url_effective}'"\\n\" \""'$url" -o "$work_tmp/$name.html" || true
  printf '"'%s\\n' \"--- "'$url ---"
  rg -n -i -C 2 '"'Badod|college|course|admission|api|search|Agar' \""'$work_tmp/$name.html" | head -140 || true
done
printf '"'%s\\n' \"tmp="'$work_tmp"'
